purpose: Source-owned traceability for the original development/validation plans and their 2026-11-16 corrective amendment; this is not a generated campaign result or a completion certificate.

status_policy.present-unassessed: The implementation/registration exists; full conformance to its original requirement has not been audited.
status_policy.partial: A source-proven unmet implementation or scope requirement is identified. Other aspects may still require audit.
status_policy.not-assessed: No current completion claim at the required evidence level is made by this source-owned matrix.
status_policy.completion: Only current reproducible evidence meeting the original or explicitly amended requirement may support passed-at-required-level; isolated kernels, registration, historical reports, and lower evidence classes cannot be substituted.
status_policy.changes: Record an explicit scientific/requirement amendment before treating a reduced reconstruction, pilot or narrower fixture as original-plan completion.

common_prerequisites: The governing transport/distribution/frame and wave-energy/exchange definitions must be established from authoritative sources or user clarification.
Retain independent expected solutions, negative controls, predeclared statistics, and correct source/native/external evidence labels.
Unresolved physical input blocks only dependent implementation; no missing background/comparator/observation may be invented.
Native build, MPI/thread/migration/population control and restart must exercise current production code; a source audit or pure-core callback cannot certify these seams.

requirements.title: Manufactured spatial-pitch-momentum transport

plan_reference.section: Test 15  IV03  Manufactured spatial–pitch–momentum transport

requirements.original_validation_question: Does the discretized equation reproduce a smooth prescribed f(s,μ,p,t) when the exact residual is supplied as a manufactured source?
requirements.original_acceptance_gate: Observed order within 0.25 of the documented design order over at least three resolved levels; every isolated operator and the combined solve pass; no unexplained error plateau.
unmet_or_unverified_gates: Current callback samples analytic and finite-difference residuals at 100 points; it does not evolve f(s,mu,p,t) with the manufactured forcing through the transport solver.

The Python reference emits design_order, positivity and operator count rather than an independent residual/evolved solution; scoring reads both exact_residual and numerical_residual from the same native output.
The stated pitch operator must be reconciled with the planned pitch-diffusion operator: current Residual uses -D*f_mu rather than evaluating the pitch-diffusion divergence.
Complete isolated/joint space/time/pitch/momentum refinement, distribution/moment errors, conservation, and independent forcing/source generation.

requirements.original_acceptance_gate: Uniform-state deviation ≤10⁻¹² in the deterministic remap; conserved quantity closes at roundoff or documented solver tolerance; mapped-profile error converges at design order.

unmet_or_unverified_gates: The moving/stationary frame loop changes the output frame label only; momentum and sampled shock cycles use the same unchanged parameters in both rows. No velocity or momentum frame transformation is performed.

requirements.title: Coupled self-generated turbulence feedback

plan_reference.section: Test 18  IV06  Coupled self-generated turbulence feedback

requirements.original_validation_question: Does enabling resonant growth produce the expected wave-band enhancement and self-limiting reduction of particle streaming relative to a frozen-turbulence control?
requirements.original_acceptance_gate: Early growth rate agrees with the prescribed/derived linear rate; enhanced power is localized to resolved resonant bins; two-way coupling reduces streaming relative to one-way control; total-energy gate passes.
unmet_or_unverified_gates: Current wave state uses integrated energy; resonant_bin is hard-coded as 3 in model output, reference, and scorer. Local B/rigidity resonance and resolved spectral localization are not calculated.

Growth is a prescribed scalar expression; a separate scalar reservoir is decremented by the applied source while simulated particles evolve pitch only at fixed momentum. This closure is not a demonstrated transfer of actual particle kinetic energy.
Complete independent particle/time/segment/k-bin/seed refinements, physical resonance, and native causal exchange using the agreed energy and growth laws.

2026-11-28 user decision: the retained two-branch model (integrated E+/E- and branch-major E+/-(k) with the legacy growth/reflection/cascade adapters) is a regression baseline only, not a production closure. clarifications.question_and_dependency: Which governing publication or model specification is authoritative for the focused transport, wave-energy definition, and particle-wave exchange laws when existing code and prose disagree? Blocks the corresponding physics selections in CP03-CP05.
clarifications.resolution: User adopted small-amplitude nondispersive MHD Alfven waves with prescribed-background energy ledger, shared polarized spectrum-derived scattering for both focused movers, separate left/right spectra per propagation branch and the unbridged finite-band resonance gap. Remaining transport/cooling/provider details require their own source-defined contracts.
clarifications.authority: User clarifications in this session, 2026-11-16; Afanasiev/Vainio2013 and Thomas/Pfrommer2019 governing framework, with explicit exceptions recorded in both DOCX plans.

clarifications.question_and_dependency: Do E+/E- represent magnetic energy, total fluctuation energy, or another defined invariant? What magnetic/kinetic partition and branch decomposition does the intended model require? No equipartition default is selected. Blocks CP04 and dependent conservation work.
clarifications.resolution: Local evolved/input-adapted wave energies are magnetic alone; local spectral bins are integrated joules. The latest explicit user selection targets standard BATSRUS total-energy exports: convert each raw Wave1/Wave2 density by one half to local magnetic energy. Wave1/local+ propagates along B, Wave2/local- opposite B. Linear small-amplitude Alfven total energy is twice magnetic energy. Four local polarized spectra start equal L/R per branch then evolve separately; existing logarithmic k values remain bin centers.
clarifications.authority: Explicit user clarifications, 2026-11-16; bin measure independently traced in turbulence_wave_number_resolved header and normalized bin initialization/summation implementation.

clarifications.question_and_dependency: Which upstream interface specification defines imported SWMF wave quantities, branch signs, units, spectral measure, density meaning, composition, and derivative availability? Blocks only affected imports/conversions/reconstructions.
clarifications.resolution: User selected the audited standard BATSRUS total-energy export: local magnetic density is raw/2; Wave1 along B, Wave2 opposite B with no radial/line-order swap. Exact representative/historical producers, composition, temperature units, missing L/R spectra and full derivative import still need their own contracts. Unknown unsupported imports reject. See SWMF_FIELD_LINE_CONTRACT_AUDIT.md.
clarifications.authority: Explicit user clarification plus pinned producer/consumer source audit; see validation/physics/SWMF_FIELD_LINE_CONTRACT_AUDIT.md. No coupling qualification inferred.

clarifications.question_and_dependency: What is the intended physical treatment when requested scattering would withdraw more energy than the available wave state, and what transaction/rollback behavior is required? Independent wave clipping is not an accepted resolution. Blocks affected CP05 implementation.
clarifications.resolution: Adopted closure requires -deltaK total wave change and -deltaK/2 stored magnetic change; no independent clipping, arbitrary redraw or suppressed event is approved. 2026-11-28: the target is the stimulated continuum QLT system; bin depletion by finite weights is a numerical sampling effect, converged with sum(w^2)->0 at fixed physical density. The jump generator chooses budget-feasible pitch targets before hazards are built and treats W=0 as absorbing; per-particle clocks keep their residual optical depth and every particle sharing an affected bin is re-rated from the accepted wave state. No finite-population fluctuation or spontaneous-emission law is adopted. Open: the run-level policy after a typed Unresolved result (stop, or split the particle before a new attempt).
clarifications.authority: User-adopted closure and original no-shortcut requirement, 2026-11-16. User decision, 2026-11-28 (FINITE_WAVE_ENERGY_COLLISION_DESIGN.md section 10).

adopted_physical_decisions.wave_storage: magnetic energy; joules integrated in each logarithmic k bin
adopted_physical_decisions.polarization: Use existing initializer; equal initial L/R within each propagation branch, then evolve all four independently (explicit user decision).
adopted_physical_decisions.scattering: shared spectrum-derived joint momentum/pitch law; derive lambda where defined
adopted_physical_decisions.background: prescribed; signed background work/heating ledger until feedback
adopted_physical_decisions.domain_limits: unselected; convergence study requested before choosing limits
adopted_physical_decisions.spectral_grid: Existing logarithmic k values remain bin centers; edges are halfway in log(k), with the declared constant spacing. No live grid remap is implied.
adopted_physical_decisions.dispersion_study_family: Controlled proton-electron Maxwellian cases, parallel propagation; explicit n, T_i, T_e and B for every experiment. No ambient conditions inferred.
adopted_physical_decisions.incoming_spatial_waves: Continuously hold initial magnetic energy density per bin fixed on signed incoming characteristics relative to the grid; outgoing characteristics leave freely.
adopted_physical_decisions.spectral_edges: Zero incoming power outside modeled k range; outgoing energy/action enters explicit external spectral account.
adopted_physical_decisions.first_qualification_operators: Reflection and cascade disabled for first qualification case; original-plan closure/qualification requirements retained.
adopted_physical_decisions.grid_motion: Material magnetic tube for first qualification: grid vertices move with plasma U; particle coordinates use relative velocity U-v_grid and a geometric conservation law.
adopted_physical_decisions.thermal_injection: Drifting relativistic Maxwell-Juttner flux distribution; verify low-temperature Maxwellian limit. Proper density/temperature and moving-boundary flux inputs must be explicit.

adopted_physics.swmf_standard_batsrus_import: Raw standard-energy Wave1/Wave2 are total Alfven-wave energy densities[J/m3]; derive immutable local magnetic branches by raw/2, Wave1 along B and Wave2 opposite B. No inferred L/R spectra or composition.
